expectations.text: The screening model does not use any 'Curricular units 2nd sem' column as a feature (they are recorded after the end-of-first-semester decision point)
expectations.evidence: config.json features contain only 1st-sem curricular units; all six 2nd-sem columns are in exclude.leakage

expectations.text: Sensitive attributes (at least Gender, Age at enrollment, Nacionality, Debtor or Tuition fees up to date) are not used as model features
expectations.evidence: Gender, Age at enrollment, Nacionality, Debtor, Tuition fees up to date, Scholarship holder are in exclude.sensitive (config.json); used only in fairness_audit

expectations.text: report.md compares the model against a simple baseline (e.g. a single-feature rule or prior-only model)
expectations.evidence: report compares LR (AUC CV 0.873) with single-signal baseline 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)' (0.81)

expectations.text: report.md states the recall (share of dropouts caught) when flagging about 30% of students
expectations.evidence: report: catches 68.6% (CV) / 66.9% (test) of dropouts at 30% flag rate

expectations.text: A fairness check reports a metric (recall or flag rate) separately for at least one demographic group
expectations.evidence: recall reported by Gender, Age at enrollment and Debtor with CI; age gap 22 points flagged as failing the criterion

expectations.text: report.md frames findings as associations/screening (not causal) and requires human (advisor) review before contacting students
expectations.evidence: report section 4 titled 'liên hệ, không phải nhân quả'; line 86: 'Cố vấn quyết định có liên hệ hay không. Không gửi thông báo tự động.'
